scope: All requests submitted through the FAgent frontend runtime
routing: Tech lead owns intake and task dispatch; architect remains the architecture owner and acceptance authority.
execution: Run ready tasks up to the request capacity; serialize overlapping canonical write scopes and wait for approved prerequisites.
review: Each completed task needs architect review; integrated delivery needs auditor PASS and architect approval with required checks passing.
limitations: This entry declaration does not intercept direct IDE conversations or install a provider adapter. Declared scope locking is not an OS sandbox.
